newsitem.title: USA: Tower Automotive agrees to buy Italian firm.
newsitem.headline: Tower Automotive agrees to buy Italian firm.

text.p: Tower Automotive Inc said Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Societa Industria Meccanica e Stampagio S.p.A. (SIMES), headquartered in Turin, Italy.
Terms were not disclosed. Closing is expected during the second quarter.
SIME, which make structural parts and assemblies for the automotive market, has annual revenues of about $70 million.

Tower Automotive said the acquisition is a key step in establishing its European base. Tower produces a broad range of stamped and welded assemblies for vehicle body structures and suspension systems.
